title: How to Clean and Maintain Laptop Cooling Fans
description: This video provides a step-by-step guide on performing internal maintenance on a laptop, covering the disassembly, cleaning of cooling fans, and proper reassembly.
summary: The video provides comprehensive instructions for maintaining a laptop's cooling system. It begins by demonstrating the disassembly process, including unhooking the battery and disconnecting necessary wires, followed by the identification and cleaning of the cooling fans. The speaker notes that one fan has already been cleaned to ensure optimal cooling performance. The video then guides the viewer through reassembly, explaining how to handle fan headers and hook the battery back into place after spinning the laptop. Finally, the process concludes with instructions on removing the back panel, reassembling the components, and securing them, emphasizing the importance of applying new thermal paste to keep the laptop cool.
